plan.objective: Validate the unchanged full directional multiscale reference on DC interventions outside the sixteen-photo model screen.

gates.rule: All four metric/cohort gates must pass. Report direction counts, trivial baselines, abstentions and every missed harm. No subset selection.

plan.diagnostics: Reuse verified reconstructed-channel restoration with saved AC/filter decisions. Score fixed reconstructions with native Butteraugli and SSIMULACRA2, then predict Butteraugli with the unchanged passing model. SSIM results are descriptive; the model does not predict SSIM.
plan.limits: One fixed validation only. No formula changes, fitting, new encodes, encoder changes, joint RD, peer decisions or holdout access. All quality, speed, memory and promotion gates unchanged. Stop after report; no promotion claim.
plan.preparation: Only fixture metadata and file existence/size inspected. No streams decoded, diagnostic images generated or quality scores read by this proposal script.
